illustration.description: Two side-by-side full-body human figures standing against a plain white wall with a soft shadow at the base, rendered as dark translucent bodies with glowing orange rim light and an inner glowing orange-yellow spine. Left figure: arms bent with hands raised at shoulder height, pressed against the wall, head facing forward, relaxed stance with bare feet. Right figure: same body with arms fully extended straight up overhead, hands flat against the wall, head facing forward, bare feet. Cinematic, clean medical-diagram style with smooth stylized anatomy, warm orange and amber glow on near-black silhouettes, soft studio lighting, pure white background.
